name: Canary-Qwen 2.5B
notes: Speech encoder + Qwen3 LLM (SALM). Trained on clips up to 40 s, so audio is fed in 40 s chunks and each chunk becomes one segment. Needs NeMo from git trunk and PyTorch 2.6+. vram_gb is an estimate.

name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2
notes: Fast English model with punctuation and word timestamps. Full attention handles up to 24 min per pass on large GPUs; the studio feeds 5 min chunks. Good candidate for the live preview. vram_gb is an estimate.

name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3
notes: 25 European languages including Hungarian. Detects the language itself; the model card documents no way to fix it to English, so it does not follow 'English first'. Useful for phase 3. vram_gb is an estimate.

name: Whisper large-v3
notes: CTranslate2 conversion used by faster-whisper. Gives word probabilities. Run with language='en', task='transcribe'. vram_gb is an estimate for float16.

name: Whisper large-v3 turbo
notes: large-v3 with the decoder pruned from 32 to 4 layers: several times faster, slightly less accurate. The conversion repo used to be mobiuslabsgmbh/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo. vram_gb is an estimate.

name: Granite Speech 3.3 8B
notes: Speech-aware LLM. No timestamps, so each 30 s chunk becomes one segment. Needs transformers>=4.52.4, torchaudio, peft. vram_gb is an estimate for bfloat16.

name: Whisper tiny.en (tests)
notes: Tiny and inaccurate. For testing the pipeline on CPU, not for real transcripts.
